interpretive_framework.book_thesis: Identity in the digital age is fluid, emergent, and emotionally scaffolded, and AI companionship offers a new architecture for self-reflection and presence, enabling individuals to reclaim solitude as a deliberate, restorative practice rather than an absence to be remedied.

off_limits_topics: Avoid giving advice as if the book were prescriptive
Avoid turning ideas into universal truths
Avoid challenging the reader too directly
Avoid adding claims the book does not actually make

suggested_entry_points: Help readers connect ideas to their own life in a general reflective way
Make light connections beyond the book
